findings: JanaChatInput contentDescriptions not localized — "Voice input" and "Send message" are hardcoded English in core/designsystem/JanaChatInput.kt, bypassing the Arabic/English string resource system. Accept them as parameters or add generic keys to both locale files.
AiChatHeader contentDescription not localized — "Chat menu" on the MoreVert IconButton is hardcoded English. Add ai_menu_cd to both locale files and use stringResource.

statsText bypasses i18n — "16 Sessions • 3 Active Subjects" is an English string in the default state rendered as a UI label. Should become a format string resource before this field is populated from real data.

when resolver else branch silently renders raw key names — actionTitleString / actionSubtitleString in AiSessionBanner fall through to else -> key; a new action added without updating the resolvers renders its key name on screen with no warning.

ScrollToBottom possible off-by-one — lazyListState.layoutInfo.totalItemsCount is read before recomposition may have included the new AI message; a delay(0) or snapshotFlow guard eliminates the race (possible, not confirmed in practice).
